releases.title: this is who i am
releases.notes: Instrumental pieces reflecting the inner landscape I move through every day. These tracks live in that space where emotions overlap — where something can feel beautiful and heavy at the same time. No lyrics, because this project isn't about explaining anything — it's about feeling it.

releases.title: Nothings Ever Really Finished
releases.notes: Songs created over six to seven years — some completed, some abandoned, some resurrected, many left intentionally unresolved. An adventure record. The second release on Last of the Real Estate — a label built around the idea that attention, time, land, and truth are the last things we truly own.

releases.title: Jakey Boy “The last of the ninja twins”
releases.notes: This album is a memorial. Written in September 2022 during a week of fear, hope and unbearable waiting, while my brother Jacob fought addiction. Jacob was found dead in a stairwell, overdosed on fentanyl. These songs came from a place where love and dread existed at the same time.

bio: We're an artist-led project releasing music to support recovery-centered, land-based living. What we make helps fund food, shelter, creative space, and mutual care. This isn't hype or a label chasing trends — it's real people, real art, and slow, intentional work rooted in community.
